title: On the codegree Turán density of projective geometries
summary: Let $F$ be a $k$-uniform hypergraph, abbreviated as $k$-graph. The codegree Turán density $γ(F)$ is the supremum over all $γ\in [0,1)$ such that, for arbitrarily large $n$, there exists an $n$-vertex $F$-free $k$-graph $H$ whose every $(k-1)$-subset of vertices lies in at least $γn$ edges. Let $PG_m(q)$ be the projective geometry of dimension $m$ over finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$. In this paper, we prove that $γ(PG_m(q)) \ge \frac{1}{p}> 0$ for all $m$ and $q$, where $p$ is the smallest prime divisor of $q+1$.
